mapper.insert: INSERT INTO failed_hr_event ( source_approval_id, target_employee_state, effective_from, reason, payload_json, failure_message, retry_count, status, last_retry_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceApprovalId}, #{targetEmployeeState}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{reason}, #{payloadJson}, LEFT(#{failureMessage}, 500), 0, 'PENDING', NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE effective_from = VALUES(effective_from), reason = VALUES(reason), payload_json = VALUES(payload_json), failure_message = VALUES(failure_message), retry_count = 0, status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT failed_event_id AS failedEventId, source_approval_id AS sourceApprovalId, target_employee_state AS targetEmployeeState, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, reason AS reason, payload_json AS payloadJson, retry_count AS retryCount FROM failed_hr_event WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} ORDER BY created_at ASC, failed_event_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE failed_hr_event SET status = 'RETRYING', last_retry_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE failed_event_id = #{failedEventId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
UPDATE failed_hr_event SET status = 'RESOLVED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE failed_event_id = #{failedEventId}

UPDATE failed_hr_event SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, failure_message = LEFT(#{failureMessage}, 500), status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetryCount} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE failed_event_id = #{failedEventId}
